scripts.android:install: adb wait-for-device && adb shell 'while [ -z "$(getprop sys.boot_completed)" ]; do sleep 1; done' && ./gradlew installDebug
scripts.android:deploy: ./gradlew assembleDebug && adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb shell am start -n com.nutrisense.mobile/.MainActivity
